title: 10990-11010 WEST PICO BOULEVARD; BOARD FILE NO. 260066
text:
[D. PUBLIC HEARINGS regarding EXPORT-IMPORT applications pursuant to Section 91.7006.7.5]
10990-11010 WEST PICO BOULEVARD; BOARD FILE NO. 260066
  C.D.: 5 (Councilmember Katy Young Yaroslavsky); West Los Angeles Planning Area

  STAFF MEMBER:  Joaquin Greenough
  BUREAU/DIVISION:  Inspection/Grading

  APPLICANT:  Khoa Ho – Three6ixty

  Consideration of Application to export 12,507 cubic yards of earth from the project site; and
  consideration whether the project is categorically exempt under CEQA pursuant to Section 15332
  (Class 32) of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines (Case No. ENV-2026-
  3548-CE), and there is no substantial evidence demonstrating that an exception to a categorical
  exemption pursuant to CEQA Guidelines, Section 15300.2 applies.

  ACTION BY THE BBSC IS APPEALABLE TO THE CITY COUNCIL WITHIN TEN DAYS PURSUANT TO
  SECTION 91.7006.7.5.
